t: Sunbeam EM5300 Barista Max: CLEAN light fully lit (blue)
m: The group head and shower head need a cleaning cycle.

t: Sunbeam EM5300 Barista Max: ON/OFF light pulsing
m: The thermoblock is heating up. Steady means ready.

t: Sunbeam EM5300 Barista Max: STEAM light flashing
m: Warming up to steam temperature, or cooling and purging water down to espresso temperature.

t: Sunbeam EM5300 Barista Max: DIAL light flashing
m: The dial needs returning to the vertical position.

t: Sunbeam EM5300 Barista Max: GRINDER light flashes while grinding
m: The hopper gates are not fully open.

t: Sunbeam EM5300 Barista Max: GRINDER light red
m: The grinder motor is in protection mode (overheat protection after long use).

t: Sunbeam EM5300 Barista Max: GRINDER light does not light
m: The machine is not plugged in or switched on, or the bean hopper is not seated (the interlock pin is not engaged).

t: Sunbeam EM5300 Barista Max: ON/OFF and STEAM lights flashing together after holding ON/OFF and TWO CUP for 4 seconds
m: The descaling cycle has started.

t: Sunbeam EM5300 Barista Max: Water on the benchtop
m: The drip tray overflowed, or it was missing during the automatic purge.

t: Sunbeam EMM7200 Café Series Duo: FILL TANK light on, machine beeps
m: The machine is low on water.

t: Sunbeam EMM7200 Café Series Duo: STANDBY light lit and pulsing
m: The machine is heating up.

t: Sunbeam EMM7200 Café Series Duo: Lights dim
m: Eco mode after 1 hour of inactivity; after a further 4 hours the machine beeps once and switches off.

t: Sunbeam EMM7200 Café Series Duo: Red water level indicator visible through the drip tray grill
m: The drip tray is full.

t: Sunbeam EMM7200 Café Series Duo: Control-panel lights “chase” from left to right
m: A cleaning or descaling cycle is running.

t: Sunbeam EMM7200 Café Series Duo: Beeps and the 1 CUP button flashes (during descaling)
m: The 14 pump and rest cycles have finished and the machine is ready for the purge.

t: Sunbeam EMM7200 Café Series Duo: Will not turn on or wake from standby
m: The Hot Water lever and/or the Steam lever is not in the OFF position.

t: Sunbeam EMM2900 The Compact Barista: STANDBY, 1 CUP, 2 CUP and STEAM buttons flash 5 times
m: The machine needs descaling.

t: Sunbeam EMM2900 The Compact Barista: STANDBY, 1 CUP, 2 CUP and STEAM buttons flash continuously
m: Sunbeam says the coffee machine is faulty.

t: Sunbeam EMM2900 The Compact Barista: 1 CUP and 2 CUP buttons flash rapidly
m: The dial must be returned to OFF (after more than 215 mL of hot water, or because it was left on), or the thermoblock needs to cool.

t: Sunbeam EMM2900 The Compact Barista: STEAM button flashes rapidly
m: Steam has been running continuously for more than 3 minutes.

t: Sunbeam EMM2900 The Compact Barista: Machine beeps
m: The dial is not in the OFF position.

t: Sunbeam EMM2900 The Compact Barista: Water leaking from the bottom
m: Too much water in the drip tray, or the machine is damaged.

t: Sunbeam EMM4500BK Origins Slimline: CLEAN light lit
m: A cleaning cycle is required.

t: Sunbeam EMM4500BK Origins Slimline: All control-panel lights flashing slowly and the unit is not working
m: The unit has stopped heating because of heavy use. Sunbeam describes this as a normal safety feature. There may also be no water in the tank.

t: Sunbeam EMM4500BK Origins Slimline: CLEAN light pulsing for the whole descale
m: The descaling program is running.

t: Sunbeam EMM6500GR Origins Sense: Alert indicator steady on, with a beep
m: The water in the reservoir is at or below the minimum level. The machine still works.

t: Sunbeam EMM6500GR Origins Sense: Alert indicator flashing, with 3 beeps
m: The tank ran dry and the pump stopped.

t: Sunbeam EMM6500GR Origins Sense: Alert indicator pulsing
m: The selection dial needs returning to the 12 o’clock position.

t: Sunbeam EMM6500GR Origins Sense: Clean icon lit
m: A cleaning cycle needs to be run.

t: Sunbeam EMM6500GR Origins Sense: Clean icon flashing
m: The machine needs descaling.

t: Sunbeam EMM6500GR Origins Sense: Grinder not working and its button flashing (the machine beeps if the three main buttons also flash)
m: The grinder has overheated.

t: Sunbeam EMM6500GR Origins Sense: Power indicator pulsing
m: The machine is warming up.
